newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures higher, return to midrange.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures higher, return to midrange.

text.p: May 28 - IMM currency futures higher, off highs. Flows were moderate before Buba statement at 1200 CDT/1700 GMT on alterations to its accounting methods. Report expected to lay out any plans for gold revaluation. Earlier, marks began to recover after Buba denied rumors Buba president Tietmeyer was resigning. June marks slammed into resistance at $0.5912.
